speaker.name: Data Dave

output.objection: You are framing the removal of my manual spot checks as a loss, but I am asking you to acknowledge that I am trading that labor for a reduction in my own workload. You need to state that trade explicitly in the project charter before we proceed.
output.correction: You filed this as a resistance to change, but that is not what I said. I am offering a conditional acceptance where I agree to automated checks only if they demonstrably cut down the time I spend on manual validation.
